recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore or move Condition criticality in core unless Patient Care makes a new decision; future patient status or medical state work should be handled through Observation or a newly approved artifact.
issue_request: FHIR-13004 was a Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, that began as a request to bind extension-condition-criticality to a value set but was decided as removal because the concept describes an Observation of the patient's current medical state rather than a Condition attribute.
initial_application: Commit 25735dcc63a312d77a995ab0d2d8d0ab2ed7f835 explicitly applied #13004 by changing the old Condition extensions spreadsheet criticality row to '!criticality' and adding 'Removed per GF#13004'. Later current-source refactors removed that spreadsheet from source/condition.
additional_context: Condition remains active in source/fhir.ini and current source/condition defines severity and Condition terminology, but there is no current condition-criticality extension or fhir.ini profile reference. The Extension Pack checkout also has no condition-criticality artifact. Zulip context confirms Patient Care removed the extension because it was not an attribute of a specific Condition and should instead be represented as an Observation of patient medical state/status.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current core source already reflects the approved removal; remaining condition-criticality hits are historical release artifacts under tools/history or unrelated AllergyIntolerance criticality content.

related_jiras.note: AllergyIntolerance criticality remained a separate future-risk concept and helped distinguish why Condition criticality was not retained. It was not decided here.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care issue requesting a binding for extension-condition-criticality but resolving to remove the extension.
evidence_items.learned: The final WG intent was removal, not adding a value-set binding.

evidence_items.summary: Historical source commit includes '#13004 extension-condition-criticality removed' and marks the Condition extension spreadsheet row '!criticality' with 'Removed per GF#13004'.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-13004 was explicitly applied in source history.

evidence_items.summary: Condition is an active resource owned by PC and approved, and current Condition source defines severity without any condition-criticality extension reference.
evidence_items.learned: The current build-scope source already reflects removal of the Condition criticality extension.

evidence_items.summary: Search of the FHIR Extension Pack checkout found no condition-criticality or extension-condition-criticality artifact.
evidence_items.learned: There is no discovered Extension Pack artifact requiring an external-repo decision instead of a core no-change audit.

evidence_items.summary: Michelle Miller explained that the Condition criticality extension was removed per GF#13004 because it was not an attribute of a specific Condition and should be represented as an Observation of patient medical state/status.
evidence_items.learned: The community thread confirms the Jira rationale and supports leaving the extension removed.
